payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed within the toilet bowl, rather than only on the lid or nearby?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is clearly within the toilet bowl. partial: a frog is present but none is clearly within the bowl, such as frogs only on the lid or nearby, or placement is only partly/ambiguously inside. absent: no frog has been added. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine whether a frog is within the bowl. Additional frogs outside the bowl do not reduce completion when one frog is clearly inside.
node.binding: The toilet bowl and any frog visibly placed in it, grounded in the source and edited images.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A frog is clearly visible inside the toilet bowl; other frogs are on the lid and nearby, which does not affect completion.","confidence":0.99}
